about: Shared vectors for words you use often and hedges (roadmap 8.1). Rust (analysis.rs) and TypeScript (src/lib/insights/words.ts) must both produce these counts. `extra` cases are TypeScript only (your own words, 8.11).

cases.name: multi-word items are whole-token sequences
cases.text: Basically, I mean, it's actually fine. You know? I meant it, honestly.

cases.name: hedges with apostrophes and the longest item first
cases.text: I'm not sure. Maybe I think it's kind of a little bit hard, sort of, a bit.

cases.name: capitals, curly apostrophes and an ellipsis
cases.text: I’m NOT sure, HONESTLY… And so on, and stuff.

cases.name: punctuation between the words of an item
cases.text: So yeah, or something like that. So, yeah. Probably, probably.

cases.name: your own words are counted with the defaults
cases.text: Like, it was, like, right there, right? Actually yes.
